`hermes-completed.json` records the native Hermes API adapter, AIAgent and SessionDB against our loopback model simulator (`hermes_context_contract.py`), captured from Hermes commit `fe04d5b36de1bc2d69d91185f4955c37aaef8c39`. It contains only synthetic text. Provider metadata, timing and identifiers are excluded by an explicit field allowlist.

The native contract compares a fresh capture against this fixture for both providers. Browser tests replay it with batched and fragmented delivery. This is a completed-turn contract, not a recording of production traffic or evidence covering every interruption/tool sequence. Existing constructed regressions cover those sequences separately. Review any contract drift before deliberately updating the fixture; never automatically accept new snapshots.
